<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Home Services Complaint Form">48531a92c3e26e10ca67153ed40131e9</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Supporting Documents</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
    var attachments = g_form.getAttachments();

    for (var i = 0; i < attachments.length; i++) {
        var fileName = attachments[i].file_name.toLowerCase();

        if (!(fileName.endsWith('.pdf') || fileName.endsWith('.png') || fileName.endsWith('.jpeg'))) {
            g_form.addErrorMessage('Only PDF, PNG, or JPEG files are allowed.');
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-07 16:25:07</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>55157a56c3a66e10ca67153ed401315b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Supporting Documents</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Home Services Complaint System" source="x_1777185_home_s_0">2494ce5dc3a2e610ca67153ed40131f2</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Home Services Complaint System">2494ce5dc3a2e610ca67153ed40131f2</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_55157a56c3a66e10ca67153ed401315b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-07 16:25:36</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
